name: JPG
recent: JPG 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，并宣布每股 1.50 仙的中期股息。同期，公司发布了一份谅解备忘录（MOU），并持续进行股份回购。雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报大股东权益变动。
notable: 宣布每股 1.50 仙的单层中期股息，除权日为 2026 年 11 月 26 日。
签署了一份谅解备忘录（MOU），具体内容未在标题中披露。
risks: EPF 和 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报大股东权益变动，需关注其持股变化。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 4.1584 亿令吉，环比增长 16.6%，同比增长 4.4%；净利润为 5114.9 万令吉，环比增长 1.6%，但同比下降 32.0%。净利率为 12.3%，低于上一季度的 14.1%。

recent_en: JPG announced its 3Q 2026 results and declared an interim dividend of 1.50 sen per share. During the same period, the company entered into a memorandum of understanding (MOU) and continued share buybacks. EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November.
notable_en: Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 1.50 sen per share, with ex-date on 26 Nov 2026.
Entered into a memorandum of understanding (MOU), details not disclosed in the title.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November; their shareholding changes warrant attention.
earnings_en: For 3Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM415.84 million, up 16.6% QoQ and 4.4% YoY; net income was RM51.149 million, up 1.6% QoQ but down 32.0% YoY. Net margin was 12.3%, lower than 14.1% in the previous quarter.
